segments.text: The password for bandit four is in a hidden file inside a directory called inhere.
I log in as bandit3 with ssh bandit3@bandit.labs.overthewire.org -p 2220.
A plain listing hides names that begin with a dot, so I run ls minus l a on inhere.
The listing shows dot and dot dot, and one hidden file named with three leading dots: Hiding-From-You.
I cat it by its full path, inhere slash dot dot dot Hiding-From-You.
It prints the password for bandit four, and the level is solved.
